h1: Order status updates that keep customers informed
overview: Most order questions are really a request for news. We set up the messages that give it: an order confirmation, a shipped email with tracking, a delivery update and a delay notice. We write them in your voice, test each one with a real order and make sure the tracking link opens the right page. For stores that want it, we add a tracking page, so customers can check progress without writing to you.

faq: Where do the tracking updates come from?
From the carrier through your store or tracking app. We check that the tracking number reaches the customer, and that status changes such as delivered are picked up correctly.
Do text messages need customer permission?
Yes. We set up opt-in wording that follows the rules for text messages, and we send only to those who agreed. We do not send marketing under a service message.
Can I send messages in other languages?
Yes, where your platform supports translated notifications. Tell us which languages you need, and we write or check the versions with you.
Will this stop customers from emailing me?
It should cut down the common where is my order questions. We cannot promise to remove them all, but clear updates normally leave much less for customers to ask.
